How to Install Cleaner One Pro
Views:
Follow this simple guide to install Trend Micro Cleaner One Pro on your Mac or Windows computer. In some countries, this software is called
Trend Cleaner Pro
.
System Requirements
Before installing, make sure your computer meets these requirements:
Windows:
Windows 10 or higher
macOS:
macOS 10.15 Catalina or higher
Why Use Trend Micro Cleaner One Pro?
Trend Micro Cleaner One Pro helps your computer run faster by cleaning up unnecessary files and managing startup programs. It also protects your privacy.
How to Install Cleaner One Pro on Mac
You can install Cleaner One Pro on your Mac in two ways:
From the Mac App Store
Click the link below:
Get Cleaner One Pro on App Store
Open thhe
App Store
.
Click
Get
, then
Install
.
Open the app from your
Applications
folder.
Follow the instructions on the screen to set it up.
Direct Download
Click the link below:
Download Cleaner One Pro installer
Open the downloaded file from your
Downloads
folder.
Drag the Cleaner One Pro icon to the
Applications
folder.
Open the app from your
Applications
folder.
Follow the instructions on the screen to set it up.
How to Install Cleaner One Pro on Windows
To install Cleaner One Pro on your Windows computer, follow these steps:
Click the link below:
Get Cleaner One Pro on Microsoft Store
Click
Get
, then
Open
when prompted.
Click
Get
again, then
Install
.
Open the app.
Follow the instructions on the screen to set it up.
Cleaner One Pro – AI PC Edition
If you have an AI PC, you can use the AI PC edition of Cleaner One Pro. Follow the same steps as the Windows installation above with this installer:
Cleaner One Pro - AI PC Edition - Free download and install on Windows | Microsoft Store
Why Use the AI PC Edition?
The
AI PC edition
uses advanced technology to make your computer run even better and protect your personal information.
